title: Court Leave for Compounding of Offence

content.scenario: A consumer in India files a complaint under section 92. The court must grant leave for compounding of the offence.
content.outcome: The court grants leave for compounding of the offence, allowing the consumer to pay a prescribed amount, which does not exceed the maximum amount of the fine.

user_queries: What is the process for compounding of an offence in India?
How does the court grant leave for compounding of an offence?
What are the limitations for compounding of an offence in India?
